title: erigeron delphiniifolius subsp. neomexicanus
intro: Erigeron delphiniifolius subsp. neomexicanus, commonly known as the New Mexican fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include pain relief, wound healing, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating minor injuries and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the New Mexican fleabane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
